manifestChangelog: v2 (2026-07-28): per-skill files[] mappings (src in this repo -> dest in a brain) so the assembler can build a new brain straight from the registry; shell component versioned; update-skill + ferryman-adapter-contract now bundled. All v1 fields unchanged — /update keeps working.

shell.changelog: Structure default (folder skeleton + per-folder readmes + SETUP/SHELL/WHAT-YOU-GET + CLAUDE.md with {{INHABITANT}} placeholders). Cast 2026-07-09.
shell.note: Assembler clones this, then installs the skills below. Versioned here so structure updates can propagate like skill updates. Phase 2: host the shell + serve via GET /api/v1/pack.

skills.changelog: People fold (mandatory: dated folds + facet maintenance + create-on-recurrence, cards never push to the app) + corrected push facts (upsert-by-id works; Action Items land Pending Review by design).
skills.blurb: processes your meeting/mentor-call transcripts into app-matching summaries + action items (preset parity); answers questions about transcripts; surfaces prompts discussed in calls; runs the mandatory People fold into `people/` cards after every transcript.

skills.changelog: Settled pipeline: push.py --push-summary (due-hygiene in code), pipeline-verify.py, intake reports -> transcripts/import-reports/, ferryman-rules.md ships, upsert-by-id, genericized (your token, your folders).
skills.blurb: sync between your PF App account (your own personal token) and your local app mirror. PULL/STATUS via `pull.py`; PUSH is LIVE via `push.py --push-summary` (validate-first, upsert-by-id); `pipeline-verify.py` checks the invariants. Intake procedure: [[skills/ferryman/transcript-intake-runbook.md]].

skills.changelog: NEW component: people cards as facets/prose/folds with a machine adapter (list / get-with-strip-tier / verify) + base facet registry. Cards never push to the app.
skills.blurb: the machine door to `people/` cards — `people.py --list` (frontmatter facets), `--get <slug>` (shareable/full tiers, [private] always stripped), `--verify` (schema + fold checks against `people/facets.json`). People cards NEVER push to the app — brain-side only.
